title: Containers, not collections
preamble:
# Containers, not collections

The standing constraint that DS
provides containers and does not provide collections, and
the gate every proposal introducing or extending a data
grouping must pass. Zero grammar surface — this doc
constrains what may be added to the language, not what the
language already spells.

Paired with:

- [LSCO] — the narrow surface this doc
  generalises to every data grouping.
- [LDET] — the bounded-cost
  requirement one of these rejections falls out of.
- [LEXP] — `Json`, a
  container whose surface the doctrine shaped.
- [LSER] — series and signals, the other
  container: closed aggregations, no per-sample access.
- [LCRS] — the adapter
  boundary iterative logic is pushed across.
summary: The container-vs-collection line: what DS admits as a data grouping, and the gate every new grouping must pass.
